author: Stahly
description:
A new era for the underhive is here. In this review, we're unboxing the 2026 Necromunda Skirmish Core Set that marks the start of a new and streamlined edition of Necromunda. We're taking a look at the new Core Rulebook, and examining the Goliath and Escher gangs in detail. Alongside the full unboxing video, you'll find high-res sprue images and a complete breakdown of all the build options in this post.

The post Necromunda Skirmish Core Set review: streamlined or skimped? appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Necromunda Skirmish Core Set review: streamlined or skimped?
